claims.claim: The repository provides bounded optional parallel-verification dependencies and documents them as one-time BP-V4 measurement/test provisioning without changing core runtime dependencies or installing packages during probe execution.

The BP-V4 contract accepts only explicit ascending worker candidates from 2, 3, and 4; treats one valid probe as full-suite measurement coverage; prevents duplicate measurement authorization; and fails closed for malformed probe-family invocations, including Windows-style paths, while preserving unrelated opaque commands.

One probe performs one canonical collection, one serial profile, and each authorized parallel profile exactly once, emitting bounded structured identity, profile, conformance, and worker-isolation information.
Correctness, conformance, and missing or incompatible parallel capability fail explicitly, while timing alone remains observational and does not select or recommend a worker profile.
The implementation remains measurement tooling only and does not alter Runtime authority, lifecycle, routing, publication, verification defaults, or performance-verdict ownership.
